spec: Return the absolute value of x.
Return -1 if x is negative, 0 if x is zero, and 1 if x is positive.
Clamp x to the inclusive interval from 0 to 10: values below 0 become 0, values above 10 become 10, otherwise return x.
Return 1 if x is even, otherwise return 0.
Return the largest even integer less than or equal to x.
Return the mathematical floor of x divided by 3.
If x is odd return twice x; if x is even return x divided by 2 as an integer.
Return the smaller of x squared and 100.
Return the nonnegative distance from x to the nearest integer divisible by 5.
Return the number of decimal digits in the absolute value of x, counting 0 as one digit.
